name: Janica Callahan
title: Executive Assistant / Account Manager
summary: Dynamic Executive Assistant with a proven track record at several medium-sized firms and a startup, excelling in complex calendar management, client and office management. Achieved significant annual savings through optimized travel planning while enhancing stakeholder communications. Adept at problem-solving and leveraging AI agents to 10x daily outputs, ensuring efficient operations and superior client service.

highlights: Managed internal and external stakeholder communications, ensuring seamless interactions.
Drove adoption of new AI project management software.
Streamlined executive communications, reducing email clutter and improving response times.
Supported successful event execution through meticulous planning and coordination.
Serviced clients on web, mobile, and digital channels.
Provided administrative support including reports, meeting minutes, and research.
Managed executive email accounts and initiated conversations with colleagues.
Proofread and edited executive documents and communications.
Monitored and maintained executive files and records.
Prepared agendas, catering, and invites for luncheons, board meetings, and appointments.
Performed data entry, generated reports, and greeted visitors with friendly service.
Drafted, proofread, and edited confidential correspondence and documents.
Organized meetings, took minutes, and assisted with new-hire onboarding.
Developed and maintained internal and external company websites.
Managed office supplies, quotations, and business project support.
Handled VAT filing, accounts receivable, payroll, and upper-management travel.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Hotel and Restaurant Management
